opening.argument: The presentation links participation to paid trading packages whose earnings depend on building opposing teams and qualifying through downline ranks. Most importantly, it requires that “you need to at least have one person on your left and one person on your right,” making recruitment central to the compensation structure. It then presents substantial earnings, including the claim that “the 5,000 euro package is basically €35,000 per week,” alongside bonuses, prizes, and token-related gains. The model further directs 40% toward “purchase more tokens or purchase more coins,” while emphasizing increasingly expensive packages and rapid growth. Although the speaker acknowledges that “some people will make a lot more than what I am sharing with you and some people will make a lot less,” that disclaimer does not change the presentation’s central recruitment and earnings solicitation.
